title: lyogavin/airllm
title_zh: AirLLM 70B 推理：仅需单块 4GB GPU

paragraphs.en: AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU
paragraphs.zh: AirLLM 2.8T 大语言模型推理仅需单张 4GB GPU

paragraphs.en: Quickstart | Configurations | MacOS | Example notebooks | FAQ
paragraphs.zh: 快速入门 | 配置 | MacOS | 示例笔记本 | 常见问题

paragraphs.en: AirLLM dramatically reduces inference memory usage, letting 70B large language models run on a single 4GB GPU card — without quantization, distillation, or pruning. You can even run Kimi K3 (2.8T) — the largest open-source model released to date — on under 4GB , Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) on 6GB , and DeepSeek-V3 (671B) on ~12GB . We now also support training huge models on small VRAM: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) under 6GB .
paragraphs.zh: AirLLM 大幅降低推理内存占用，让 70B 大语言模型可以在单张 4GB GPU 显卡上运行——无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝。 你甚至可以在 4GB 以内运行 Kimi K3（2.8T）——迄今为止发布的最大开源模型，在 6GB 运行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（125B），在约 12GB 运行 DeepSeek-V3（671B）。 我们现在还支持在小显存上训练超大模型：6GB 以内运行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（125B）。

paragraphs.en: [2026/09] Training support: stream frozen weights one layer at a time and keep adapters on the GPU. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) trains under 6GB (RTX 3060 Ti); Qwen3.8-27B trains in ~2GB at seq 512. See Training .
paragraphs.zh: [2026/09] 训练支持：逐层流式传输冻结权重，并将适配器保留在 GPU 上。 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) 在 6GB 显存内即可训练（RTX 3060 Ti）；Qwen3.8-27B 在序列长度 512 时约 2GB 显存即可训练。详见「训练」章节。

sents.en: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) trains under 6GB (RTX 3060 Ti); Qwen3.8-27B trains in ~2GB at seq 512. See Training .

paragraphs.en: [2026/08] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next support: Qwen's 125B MoE flagship ( Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration ) with a ~51B n-gram embedding runs in 5.95GB of VRAM, measured end to end on one RTX 4090. The n-gram table is file-mapped on the host (a 64GB machine is enough); decoder layers stream. Needs a transformers build with in-tree qwen4_exp ( pip install git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git today) and ~360GB of checkpoint disk ( delete_original=True reclaims the originals after the split).
paragraphs.zh: [2026/08] 支持 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：Qwen 的 125B MoE 旗舰模型（Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration）配合约 51B 的 n-gram 嵌入，可在 5.95GB 显存中运行，端到端实测于单张 RTX 4090。 n-gram 表以文件映射方式存放在主机上（64GB 内存的机器即可）；解码器层以流式方式加载。 需要一个内置 qwen4_exp 的 transformers 构建（现在可通过 pip install git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git 安装），以及约 360GB 的检查点磁盘空间（split 后使用 delete_original=True 可回收原始文件）。

sents.en: [2026/08] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next support: Qwen's 125B MoE flagship ( Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration ) with a ~51B n-gram embedding runs in 5.95GB of VRAM, measured end to end on one RTX 4090.
sents.zh: [2026/08] 支持 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：Qwen 的 125B MoE 旗舰模型（Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration）配合约 51B 的 n-gram 嵌入，可在 5.95GB 显存中运行，端到端实测于单张 RTX 4090。

sents.en: Needs a transformers build with in-tree qwen4_exp ( pip install git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git today) and ~360GB of checkpoint disk ( delete_original=True reclaims the originals after the split).

paragraphs.en: [2026/08] Qwen3.8-27B support: Qwen's new dense VL (Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention, native vision) runs in 3.33GB of VRAM, measured end to end on one RTX 3090. Needs transformers 5.8+.
paragraphs.zh: [2026/08] Qwen3.8-27B 支持：Qwen 全新的稠密 VL 模型（Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention，原生视觉能力）可在 3.33GB 显存中运行，并在单张 RTX 3090 上完成了端到端实测。需要 transformers 5.8 及以上版本。

paragraphs.en: [2026/07] Kimi K3 (2.8T) support: the largest open-source model runs on a single card in 3.72GB of VRAM, measured end to end on one RTX 6000 Ada. Per-expert streaming loads only the experts a token actually routes to. K3 brings three requirements of its own: pip install compressed-tensors flash-attn (its model code mandates flash attention regardless of what you request), a CUDA 12 build of torch, since no prebuilt flash-attn wheel exists for CUDA 13 yet, and transformers 4.56.x, as its remote code does not load on 5.x.
paragraphs.zh: [2026/07] Kimi K3 (2.8T) 支持：这个最大的开源模型可在单卡 3.72GB 显存上运行，在一块 RTX 6000 Ada 上完成了端到端实测。 按专家的流式加载只加载令牌实际路由到的那些专家。 K3 自身带来三个要求：pip install compressed-tensors flash-attn（其模型代码无论你请求什么都强制使用 flash attention）、torch 需使用 CUDA 12 版本，因为目前还没有针对 CUDA 13 的预编译 flash-attn wheel，以及 transformers 4.56.x，因为其远程代码无法在 5.x 上加载。

paragraphs.en: from airllm import AutoModel MAX_LENGTH = 128 # just pass a hugging face repo id — works with almost any popular model: model = AutoModel . from_pretrained ( "Qwen/Qwen3-32B" ) # go bigger with the exact same one line: #model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B") # 27B dense VL, 3.33GB #model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next") # 125B MoE + 51B PLE, 5.95GB #model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B") # 235B, runs in ~3GB #model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3") # 671B, runs in ~12GB # or use a model's local path... #model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("/home/ubuntu/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-32B/snapshots/...") input_text = [ 'What is the capital of United States?' , #'I like', ] input_tokens = model . tokenizer ( input_text , return_tensors = "pt" , return_attention_mask = False , truncation = True , max_length = MAX_LENGTH , padding = False ) generation_output = model . generate ( input_tokens [ 'input_ids' ]. to ( model . device ), max_new_tokens = 20 , use_cache = True , return_dict_in_generate = True ) output = model . tokenizer . decode ( generation_output . sequences [ 0 ]) print ( output ) Note: During inference, the original model will first be decomposed and saved layer-wise. Please ensure there is sufficient disk space in the huggingface cache directory.

paragraphs.en: We just added model compression based on block-wise quantization-based model compression. Which can further speed up the inference speed for up to 3x , with almost ignorable accuracy loss! (see more performance evaluation and why we use block-wise quantization in this paper )
paragraphs.zh: 我们刚刚新增了基于分块量化的模型压缩。 它可以进一步将推理速度提升至最高 3 倍，且精度损失几乎可以忽略不计！ （更多性能评估以及我们为何使用分块量化，请参见本文）

sents.en: We just added model compression based on block-wise quantization-based model compression.
sents.zh: 我们刚刚新增了基于分块量化的模型压缩。

sents.en: Which can further speed up the inference speed for up to 3x , with almost ignorable accuracy loss!
sents.zh: 它可以进一步将推理速度提升至最高 3 倍，且精度损失几乎可以忽略不计！

sents.en: (see more performance evaluation and why we use block-wise quantization in this paper )
sents.zh: （更多性能评估以及我们为何使用分块量化，请参见本文）

paragraphs.en: model = AutoModel . from_pretrained ( "garage-bAInd/Platypus2-70B-instruct" , compression = '4bit' # specify '8bit' for 8-bit block-wise quantization ) What are the differences between model compression and quantization? Quantization normally needs to quantize both weights and activations to really speed things up. Which makes it harder to maintain accuracy and avoid the impact of outliers in all kinds of inputs.
paragraphs.zh: model = AutoModel . from_pretrained ( "garage-bAInd/Platypus2-70B-instruct" , compression = '4bit' # 指定 '8bit' 以进行 8 位分块量化 ) 模型压缩与量化之间有什么区别？ 量化通常需要同时对权重和激活进行量化，才能真正提升速度。 这使得在各类输入中保持精度并避免离群值的影响变得更加困难。

sents.en: model = AutoModel . from_pretrained ( "garage-bAInd/Platypus2-70B-instruct" , compression = '4bit' # specify '8bit' for 8-bit block-wise quantization ) What are the differences between model compression and quantization?

sents.en: Quantization normally needs to quantize both weights and activations to really speed things up.
sents.zh: 量化通常需要同时对权重和激活进行量化，才能真正提升速度。

sents.en: Which makes it harder to maintain accuracy and avoid the impact of outliers in all kinds of inputs.
sents.zh: 这使得在各类输入中保持精度并避免离群值的影响变得更加困难。

paragraphs.en: While in our case the bottleneck is mainly at the disk loading, we only need to make the model loading size smaller. So, we get to only quantize the weights' part, which is easier to ensure the accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然在我们的案例中瓶颈主要在磁盘加载，我们只需要让模型加载的大小更小。 因此，我们只需对权重部分进行量化，这样更容易保证精度。

paragraphs.en: AirLLM can fine-tune huge models on a small GPU. Frozen base weights stream from disk one decoder layer at a time; only the adapters stay resident. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) trains under 6GB ; Qwen3.8-27B trains in ~2GB at seq 512.
paragraphs.zh: AirLLM 可以在一块小型 GPU 上微调超大规模模型。 冻结的基础权重从磁盘逐解码器层流式读取；只有适配器常驻显存。 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（125B）可在 6GB 显存以下训练；Qwen3.8-27B 在序列长度 512 时约 2GB 即可训练。

paragraphs.en: from airllm import AirLLMLoRAQwen4Exp trainer = AirLLMLoRAQwen4Exp ( "Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next" , max_seq_len = 512 , lora_r = 16 , delete_original = True , ) tok = trainer . tokenizer if tok . pad_token_id is None : tok . pad_token = tok . eos_token encoded = tok ( "Your training text here." , return_tensors = "pt" , truncation = True , max_length = 512 , ) loss = trainer . train_step ( encoded [ "input_ids" ]. to ( model . device ), attention_mask = encoded . get ( "attention_mask" ), ) print ( loss ) trainer . save_adapter ( "qwen38-flash-next-lora.pt" ) AirLLMLoRA is the same API for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B .
paragraphs.zh:
```python
from airllm import AirLLMLoRAQwen4Exp

trainer = AirLLMLoRAQwen4Exp(
    "Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
    max_seq_len=512,
    lora_r=16,
    delete_original=True,
)

tok = trainer.tokenizer
if tok.pad_token_id is None:
    tok.pad_token = tok.eos_token

encoded = tok(
    "在此处填写你的训练文本。",
    return_tensors="pt",
    truncation=True,
    max_length=512,
)

loss = trainer.train_step(
    encoded["input_ids"].to(model.device),
    attention_mask=encoded.get("attention_mask"),
)

print(loss)
trainer.save_adapter("qwen38-flash-next-lora.pt")
```

AirLLMLoRA 为 Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B 提供相同的 API。

paragraphs.en: If you run into this error, most possible cause is you run out of disk space. The process of splitting model is very disk-consuming. See this . You may need to extend your disk space, clear huggingface .cache and rerun.
